Reference diffraction cell is measured at 1.28 GPa and 293 K, not ambient pressure. The fully occupied 4a site is the monatomic fcc structural model identified by Finger et al. EOS volumes refer to four-atom conventional cells. fcc/hcp coexistence is not a sharp equilibrium boundary.

Cold curve is at 0 K; Tr=296 K anchors thermal-pressure increments only. Absolute Debye thermal pressure excludes zero-point pressure. Gamma=0.5+2.2\*(V/V0). Fit coverage is quasi-hydrostatic runs 2-3 plus pure argon below 5 GPa; pure-Ar compression to 114 GPa is a separate comparison. Low-temperature validation is below about 20 GPa, not the full P-T rectangle. Paper says 300 K in fitting prose although Methods report 296 K; both are audited. No fitted parameter errors or covariance reported. Supplement contains 5.5 K and 300 K rows beyond the headline 10-296 K range.

Parameter covariance is not supplied.

<details markdown="1">
<summary>Parameter provenance</summary>

- **Origin of the parameterization:** Experimental compression fit and adopted low-temperature constraints combined with an assumed theoretical infinite-compression Gruneisen limit of 0.5.
- **V0:** Table 2: 38.0 A^3/atom multiplied by four atoms per conventional fcc cell; 0 K cold-curve parameter.
- **K0:** Table 2 and adjacent prose: fixed 2.65 GPa at 0 K.
- **K0 prime:** Table 2: fitted 7.423, uncertainty not reported.
- **Tr:** 296 K measured room temperature, Methods; increment anchor only, not a subtraction from total pressure.
- **Theta0:** Table 2 and Eq. (5), 93.3 K.
- **Gamma0:** Table 2, 2.7.
- **Gamma inf:** Eq. (4), assumed infinite-compression limit 0.5.
- **Beta:** Eq. (4): linear volume ratio, exponent one.
- **N:** Monatomic Ar, one atom per formula unit.
- **Anharmonic a:** Zero: no anharmonic term in Eq. (3).
- **Electronic e:** Zero: no electronic term in Eq. (3).
- **Anharmonic m:** One: arbitrary inactive exponent of the zero anharmonic coefficient.
- **Electronic g:** One: arbitrary inactive exponent of the zero electronic coefficient.

</details>

### Reconstruction

**Outcome:** not refittable.
**Scope:** parameter agreement.

**Comparison basis:** Published parameterization matches the official workbook; the complete global fit remains unreproduced. With equal weights on relative residuals, the best converged nine-parameter 22-volume refit lowers volume RMS from 0.0952% to 0.0322%, but gives a much too low bulk modulus and poorly constrained, bound-dependent parameters. The best converged 27-entry refit gives 0.0603% volume RMS and 0.0818% bulk-modulus RMS, but Cv = -13.88 J/mol/K at 77 K is physically unacceptable. Neither diagnostic replaces the published coefficients. Table 2 weights are published; complete legacy rows and quantitative penalties remain unavailable. Next: recover the remaining multiproperty inputs, then refit with physical constraints and assess parameter stability. \[Detailed comparison and scope\](literature-reproductions/argon-xiao-2025.md#review-conclusion-2026-09-27).

[Open reconstruction report](../reconstruction-reports/argon_fcc.md#record-argon_fcc_xiao_2025_helmholtz)

0 K cold curve includes zero-point energy; Debye thermal term excludes it. Marginal model/fit envelope 0-760 K and up to 6.3 GPa is not a rectangular solid-stability region; use solid branch below melting. New data cover 7.96-50.02 K only. Volume uncertainties estimated k=1: 0.1% sublimation, 0.5% melting/compressed; coefficient covariance/errors not published. Gas reference entropy 130.37 J/mol/K belongs to coupled fluid equilibrium model and does not enter solid pressure. No fluid fugacity/phase-equilibrium solver supplied. The complete global refit has not been reproduced from available files; workbook reference calculations are theory, not observations. The author workbook gas constant R=8.31451 J/mol/K is retained explicitly for published numerical parity. Record temperature\_ref=70 K selects the evaluation/reporting temperature; it is not the cold-curve reference temperature, which is 0 K.

Parameter covariance is not supplied.

Second-order Murnaghan means quadratic K(P), not BM2. Static P0 offset plus zero-point and absolute Debye terms. V0/K0 are adopted low-temperature constraints, not room-temperature zero-pressure solid values. Eq. (1) has an apparent extra equals sign before PT; additive form follows the described decomposition and Eqs. (2)-(6). Printed P\_z0 does not exactly cancel Eq. (2) at V0 with printed gamma1/theta0; retain all source values. Other-temperature isotherms in Fig.2 are predictions, not measured points. No solid-solid transition observed through 8.17 GPa. Uncertainty confidence level and covariance unspecified.

Parameter covariance is not supplied.
